text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day after school. I spotted Hishi 
Miracle hanging out with her friends, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Mirako, are you still sleepy? Even though 
you were dozing off during class...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I've just been feeling sleepy this 
whole time... Even though I've been 
sleeping properly at night...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Even during class... I fall asleep before 
I know it... Yaaawn..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Hishi Miracle is quite exhausted 
from running races back-to-back. It might 
be best to reconsider her upcoming 
schedule.
